thread:
anne: Quick heads-up — I pushed a small prototype for showing per-saved-query perf/cost previews in the route view. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz
raj: Nice. Is this the one that surfaces token-est / latency for the pinned model? :eyes:
anne: Yeah — we compute a lightweight estimate using recent 1h telemetry for that route + the selected model profile. It's intentionally conservative (90th pct latency).
dez: How are we getting the telemetry? Pulling from the route-telemetry API or precalc in the console backend?
anne: For the prototype it's backend calling /internal/route-metrics?window=1h, but we discussed moving it into a daily precalc table with per-route/model stats to avoid live joins.
maria: I worry about sampling mismatch. Route telemetry is sampled at 5% for hot routes; the UI preview feels misleading if we show raw numbers. Need to surface sampling rate and error bars. :thinking:
raj: Agreed. We should show a tiny hint like "based on ~12k sampled tokens (5% sampling)" and an uncertainty bar.
phil: Also: what about saved query templates that are model-agnostic? If a user uses "Any model", the preview should show a small dropdown of compatible models and their unit-costs — or an aggregated range.
anne: Good call. UX idea: when model is unspecified show 3 common model profiles (fast/medium/accurate) and let them pin one.
raj: API contract question — do we add a new field to the saved_queries object for `preview_hint` or call a separate endpoint GET /api/saved_queries/:id/preview?
dez: Prefer separate endpoint. Saved query is immutable-ish. Preview touches telemetry and pricing logic; keep it separate to reduce cache invalidation.
maria: Separate endpoint also helps feature gating for Dedicated/Private customers; we can return 403 when telemetry access is restricted.
phil: +1. Also cache the preview for 1 minute to avoid hammering metrics. We should add a `cache_ttl` header so console can retry-safely.
console-bot: deploy-bot: new feature-flag "saved_query_preview" turned on in beta for orgs in rollout group B.
anne: For rollout: start with 10% of orgs, monitor query behavior (are people looking then running?), telemetry spike risk, and error rates. Can we add a telemetry event `saved_query.preview_view` with fields {route_id, model_id, sampling_rate}?
maria: Yes. Add `sampling_rate` and `sampled_token_count` so we can compute effective uncertainty. Also add `preview_to_execute` if they run the query from the preview.
raj: UX tweak: show a small "why does this look off?" link that opens a tooltip explaining sampling and when to trust the preview. Keeps support DRI sane.
dez: Implementation note: console backend should call metrics read-model and pricing service, merge results, format into `preview` shape. Keep it a flat JSON with strings/numbers only for frontend consumption.
phil: Performance note: if multiple saved queries on a dashboard request previews simultaneously, we should batch model-profile requests and use a shared precalc table. Otherwise we might hit rate limits on metrics.
anne: I'll add an RFC for the backend shape and the frontend mock. Also adding an experiment flag to A/B test whether preview increases "run from saved query" conversions.
maria: Thanks — please include the telemetry schema in the RFC. I can review. :thumbsup:
raj: Looks good. Anne — can you drop the prototype link and the minimal API sketch here when ready?
anne: Will do by EOD. Thanks everyone.
